nodes.title: SG-8.3.2 context.md names the real stack and module paths
nodes.body:
Context: the repo-root context.md still says 'hello Worldseed', has a Traceability index, 'Frameworks: UNKNOWN' and an UNKNOWN main row. The helpers STACK_TERMS, missingTerms, missingPaths, staleTextHits and contextModulePaths already exist in game/frontend/src/lib and tests/contextDoc.test.ts already exists. Desired behavior: context.md names TypeScript, Phaser 3.90, React, Zustand, Radix and Vitest, drops the stale text, and its module table lists game/src/, game/frontend/src/, game/docs/GDD.md and backend/, all existing. Why: docs must match the code.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the repo-root context.md, when missingTerms runs with STACK_TERMS, then it returns [].
- Given the module table, when contextModulePaths runs and missingPaths checks each path on disk, then both return the four required paths and no missing ones.
- Given context.md, when staleTextHits runs, then it returns [] and 'Frameworks: UNKNOWN' is absent.


## Scope
- In scope: context.md content checked by the existing helpers and tests
- Out of scope: backend/ Go code
- Out of scope: GDD feature index (SG-8.3 other steps)
- Out of scope: gameplay changes
- Preserve: existing helper signatures
- Preserve: all existing tests
- Preserve: Phaser pin ~3.90.0


## Technical constraints
- Phaser stays pinned at ~3.90.0; phaser-pin guard test keeps passing
- npm test and npm run typecheck pass in game/ and game/frontend/
- No test deleted or skipped
- No source file in game/src or game/frontend/src over 200 lines
- game/src never imports from game/frontend
- backend/ and the contribution API are out of scope


## Definition of done
- All four tests in game/frontend/tests/contextDoc.test.ts pass


## Clarifying questions
- None
